lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; Form 2441 line 3, "If you completed Part III, enter the amount from line 31"; i2441 p. 6, Line 26, "If line 26 is more than zero, you have taxable dependent care benefits. Enter this amount on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1e". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/f2441.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 380 partial records from 40 bases; 2,375 comparisons): 717 of 2,375 agree; 1,364 candidate-unknown, 264 candidate-refuses, 24 project-unknown, 5 project-refuses, 1 value; on completed returns: 196 candidate-unknown, 26 candidate-refuses. The expression (line 26 > 0) is the earlier reply's, but this reply's line 26 is no longer guarded by f2441.benefits: it evaluates Part III for every filer, so on returns that file no Part III it asks the Part III answers the interview never asks (f2441.line13 83, Form W-2 box 10 of every employer, f2441.plan_max, line14, paid_2026, employer_care, nondependent, student_disabled) and refuses f2441.plans_differ (25) where the project gives false. No value difference on a completed return; the 1 value is on a refused return. The project tests f1040.line1e, which copies line 26 only with benefits. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i2441 p. 4, Lines 4 and 5, earned income includes "The amount shown on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 1z". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/f2441.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 380 partial records from 40 bases; 2,375 comparisons): 2,010 of 2,375 agree; 181 candidate-refuses, 144 candidate-unknown, 24 project-refuses, 16 project-unknown; on completed returns: 58 candidate-unknown, 24 candidate-refuses. The line's own choose (spouse's earned income on a joint return, else line 4; a deceased spouse's choice taken as line 4) is the earlier reply's and the project refuses the spouse-died choice (f2441.spouse_died_gate, 2). But person.dc_earned reads person.dc_1e, which reads this reply's f2441.has_1e, so the line inherits its Part III-for-every-filer error: the 24 completed-return refusals (f2441.plans_differ 23, employer_care 1) and 58 completed unknowns all trace to f2441.has_1e -> line 26 -> line 25 (witness classm.clcw.2.deepseek, traced). No value difference. The project's refusal on f2.t121.line13_earned_refused reaches line 5 through line 1e, as it must: line 1e is not determined there. Project stands.

Ruling: scope; i2441 p. 5, Line 16, "Enter the total of all qualified expenses incurred in 2025 for the care of your qualifying person(s)"; amb.2025.dc_employer_care_value. executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/f2441.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 380 partial records from 40 bases; 2,375 comparisons): 2,284 of 2,375 agree; 53 candidate-unknown, 36 candidate-refuses, 2 project-refuses; on completed returns: 30 candidate-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses. Both sum dependent.dc_paid of qualifying persons and f2441.paid_2026. The candidate refuses every return with employer-furnished care (f2441.employer_care, 27 on refused returns, 1 completed); the project computes line 16 without the value of that care when line 16 is at least line 15 and refuses otherwise (f2441.employer_care_l16, BUG-0262), the register's chosen reading (new entry amb.2025.dc_employer_care_value, T-123). The 30 completed differences are partial records withholding f2441.employer_care or f2441.nondependent, raw refusals the candidate declares where the project does not need them. No value difference. Project stands.

Ruling: scope; i2441 p. 5, Line 18, "however, for purposes of lines 18 and 19, earned income doesn't include any dependent care benefits shown on line 12"; p. 5, Line 13, "Enter on line 13 the amount you carried forward and used in 2025 during the grace period". executable-triage-v2 (rerun of triage.py's triage() with the witness cap lifted, record in scratch `/tmp/adj-bklg-dep-f2441/triage/f2441.json`; 1,495 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 380 partial records from 40 bases; 2,375 comparisons): 2,174 of 2,375 agree; 126 candidate-refuses, 44 candidate-unknown, 24 project-refuses, 7 project-unknown; on completed returns: 26 candidate-unknown, 5 project-unknown, 1 candidate-refuses. The reply's line 25 is the project's arithmetic (smaller of lines 20 and 21 with line 22 zero) without the new refusal. The new gate f2441.line13_earned (T-121, research/audits/person-dep PENDING-1) refuses line 25 only on its own regression f2.t121.line13_earned_refused in the whole sample; its two non-refusing regressions (f2.t121.line13_earned_not_limiting, f2.t121.line13_line21_binds) agree, so the gate refuses no other sampled return. There the project refuses and the candidate gives $3,000.00: lines 15 and 17 $4,500, line 18 and line 20 $3,000, line 21 $5,000, line 13 $500, so up to $500 of line 26 may be line 13's and the source does not fix line 18. The other differences are refusals (candidate f2441.h_mfs 109, employer_care, nondependent; project sa.excluded_income, s8812.combat_pay, spouse_died_gate, line14_bad, provider_ineligible) and unknowns on partial records (completed: 26 candidate-unknown withholding nondependent or employer_care, 5 project-unknown withholding f2441.spouse_died, which the interview asks on a joint return).
